title: The World's Deadliest Weather
description: Hawaii's Kilauea volcano violently erupts; Good Samaritans in Texas rescue care home residents trapped in Hurricane Harvey's deadly floodwaters; in England a paddleboarder battles high winds and treacherous tides.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description: Explore a Louisiana military base that helped save the world, then descend into a basement filled with Prohibition-era secrets; look around a bizarre castle in the Colorado mountains and a ruined Pennsylvania resort that was a Union stronghold.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description: Travel to Cairo to examine a stunning find under the Pyramid of Unas' watchful eye. Search for a 16th-century Portuguese shipwreck in the Namib Desert, unearth a WW II plane that crashed in the Sahara, and study a fossilized missing link in Taiwan.

title: River Monsters
description: On a volcanic island in the Pacific, terror grips a fishing community when something in the water leaves a trail of bloody victims in its wake; the only clues they have to the attacker's identity are the large puncture wounds it left behind.

title: Muster Dogs
description: Debbie and Snip become the mother and father of the newborn litter of pups in Goondy Creek, NSW; these pups are sent to five Australian graziers, who will each attempt to train their pup in less than a year.

title: Buried Evidence
description: Challenge long-held beliefs about Viking leadership, weaponry, and brutality; inspect a warriors tomb full of clues in Sweden, a sword of unparalleled quality in Norway, and a pile of headless skeletons in the UK that reveal unimaginable violence.

title: History Unsolved: The Investigation Files
description: Investigate the sudden death of a tycoon linked to King Tut's tomb; search for three lighthouse keepers who vanished from the Flannan Isles, then analyze the gruesome, unexplained deaths of nine hikers at the Dyatlov Pass in the Ural Mountains.

title: Mysteries From Above
description: Following a strange, 11-kilometre-long scar that cuts across the desolate Australian outback; puzzling over a jigsaw-like complex of ancient ruins in Bolivia; investigating a mysterious monolith that casts a shadow across southern Nevada.

title: Hope for Wildlife: The Next Generation
description: Follow Hope Swinimer and her team as they rescue, treat and release injured and orphaned wildlife.
